description: Climate Adaptation for DOD Natural Resource Managers is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOD, U.S. Department of Defense; National Wildlife Federation. This guide and the accompanying adaptation planning worksheets can help Department of Defense installation managers incorporate climate considerations into integrated natural resource management plans. The U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) owns or manages more than 25 million acres of land, representing a wide array of natural ecosystems that support numerous rare and endangered species. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
